key: 模型生成提议；应用组织输入、执行与结果。
The model proposes; the application organizes input, execution and results.
Transformer 组织内部计算；自回归把新片段接回已有序列。
Transformer organizes computation; autoregression feeds new pieces back into the sequence.
去噪更新当前状态；自回归追加序列，两者都使用训练好的参数。
Denoising updates a state; autoregression appends a sequence. Both use learned parameters.
写文章：先交代背景，再介绍时间、地点和参加方式。
An article needs a background paragraph, then time, place and how to join.

title: 06 上下文：把材料送进这次调用
06 Context: supply the material for this call

key: 提示词说明要做什么；上下文提供这一次真正能用的资料。
Instructions state the task; context supplies what this call can actually use.
读、写、搜索和查询由执行器完成；结果进入下一次模型调用。
An executor reads, writes, searches and queries; observations enter the next model call.
Harness 连接上下文、工具、状态与循环，让一次回答接上持续工作。
A harness connects context, tools, state and loops into ongoing work.
模型读观察、提出动作；软件执行，再把实际变化送回。
The model receives observations and proposes actions; software executes and returns actual changes.
改文稿、改助手、改模型要分开；RSI 还要求改进能力反馈到改进机制。
Separate artifact, assistant and model changes; RSI feeds improved capability into the improvement mechanism.

title: 09 从人工规则到神经网络
09 From written rules to neural networks

key: 知识图谱显式写关系；学习系统从样本调整参数，两种方法可以组合。
Graphs encode explicit relations; learned systems adjust parameters from examples. They can be combined.
y=ax+b 先说明参数；加权和加非线性，再组合成更复杂的函数。
Use y=ax+b to introduce parameters, then weighted sums and nonlinearities for richer functions.

title: 10 多 Agent：拆任务与交换结果
10 Multiple agents: split tasks and exchange results

key: 多个 Agent 通过任务与结果协作；不是 MoE 内部的参数专家。
Agents coordinate through tasks and results; they are not parameter experts inside MoE.
语料变成 Token 序列；K、M、B、T 数参数，Byte 数存储。
Corpora become token sequences. K/M/B/T count parameters; bytes measure storage.
广泛学习、集中学习和任务行为塑造，改变的是数据与训练信号。
Broad learning, focused curricula and task shaping change data and training signals.
训练题用来学习；保留题用来观察能否迁移，并核对参考答案。
Train on examples, evaluate transfer on held-out tasks and check reference answers.

title: 12 SFT、RL 与损失、奖励、优势
12 SFT, RL, loss, reward and advantage

key: Observed next token 原: probability 0.2→0.6, negative log loss 1.609→0.511.
SFT 学示范输出；RL 根据结果反馈学习，工程与科学都能组合使用。
SFT learns demonstrated outputs; RL learns from outcome feedback. Both can serve engineering and science.
奖励 1、0，基线 0.5，优势 +0.5、−0.5；奖励、优势、优化损失各有用途。
Rewards 1/0, baseline 0.5, advantages +0.5/−0.5: reward, advantage and loss have distinct roles.

title: 13 Scaling Law：数据、参数与推理计算
13 Scaling laws: data, parameters and inference compute

key: 固定预算时，模型规模 N 与数据 D 要一起分配；越大越好需要条件。
Under fixed compute, allocate model scale N and data D together; bigger requires conditions.
多想投入的是本次任务计算；有效推理与单纯等待需要用结果区分。
Extra reasoning spends inference compute; outcomes distinguish useful work from waiting.
2.8T×2 Byte≈5.6 TB 只是原始权重；运行与训练还需要额外内存。
2.8T×2 bytes≈5.6 TB counts raw weights only; inference and training require more memory.
容量决定存多少，带宽决定搬多快，计算单元执行运算。
Capacity stores, bandwidth moves data and compute units perform arithmetic.
FP16 每值 2 Byte；降低位数减少存储，但舍入、截断与任务表现都要比较。
FP16 uses two bytes per value. Fewer bits save storage; compare rounding, clipping and task outcomes.

title: 15 多卡互联、集群与推理引擎
15 GPU links, clusters and inference engines

key: 引擎安排分片和通信；NVLink 连线本身不会把多张卡变成同一块显存。
An engine implements sharding and communication; links alone do not create one transparent memory pool.

title: 17 Token 工厂：持续运行的系统
17 A token factory: sustained operation
18 选模型：生态、任务与 MoE
18 Model choice: ecosystem, task and MoE

key: 先确定任务，再检查工具链、容量、并发、稳定性和实际完成结果。
Start from the task, then compare toolchains, capacity, concurrency, consistency and outcomes.
35B 总参数、A3B 激活：少算一部分，不代表只需存 3B 权重。
35B total, A3B active: selective computation does not reduce storage to 3B weights.
识图输出文字、生成图像、生成视频，是三种不同的输入输出任务。
Image understanding, image generation and video generation are different input-output tasks.

title: 19 模型与框架怎样配合
19 Coordinating a model and its harness

key: Codex、Kimi Code 是系统例子；模型版本、工具接口与训练环境要一起看。
Read agent software, model versions, tool interfaces and training environments together.
壳的厚度描述承担多少工作：文件、工具、状态与持续循环。
Harness thickness describes responsibility for files, tools, state and ongoing work.
固定任务，每次改变一个因素，再保留正确性、时间与用量。
Fix the task, vary one factor and retain correctness, time and usage.

title: 20 AI 编程：修改、运行与反馈
20 AI coding: edit, run and observe
21 AI4S：预测怎样进入科学工作
21 AI4S: predictions in scientific work
22 让工作习惯跟着能力更新
22 Update work habits from task outcomes

key: 从复制回答，到核对已完成的工作；价值看总耗时、资源和返工。
Move from copying answers to checking completed work; value includes total time, resources and rework.
区分公司、模型、版本和应用；具体任务与版本比品牌标签更有解释力。
Separate company, family, checkpoint and application; tasks and versions explain more than brand labels.
LunaNexa 组织模型服务与集群资源，是整条 AI 工作链中的一层。
LunaNexa organizes model serving and cluster resources: one layer in the AI work chain.
